- Criterion 1 (new fact that materially weakens): not met. A rise of about half (400 to 600) is below the two-thirds growth needed for 9 percent of the new total to match or exceed 15 percent of the old total, so the fact confirms that fewer appointments are missed rather than casting doubt on that claim.
- Criterion 2 (explains how the fact weakens): not met. The arithmetic shows 54 missed now versus 60 before, which is fewer, not more, so the explanation inverts the comparison and does not show why the number failed to fall.
- Tip: Before claiming a booking increase weakens the conclusion, check that 9 percent of the new total is at least 15 percent of the old total.
